### Adam Acovski

*Hydrogeologist | Data Engineer*

Hydrogeologist and data engineer in Denver. I build calibrated groundwater models with rigorous uncertainty quantification, and the pipelines, APIs, and dashboards that put their results in front of the people making decisions.
